operations.summary: Mint a workspace API key whose value is returned once.
Revoke a workspace API key.
List workspace API key metadata.
Read the public Google OAuth configuration required by the native CLI.
Read the caller's prepaid balance and active reservations.
Detach a card owned by the caller's account.
Create a Stripe-hosted card setup session with explicit consent.
List card display metadata for the caller's account.
Create a one-time Stripe-hosted prepaid top-up checkout.
List immutable prepaid ledger transactions, newest first.
Read bounded rated usage and its settlement coverage.
One bounded read that fills the dashboard shell.
Exchange a provider authorization code for a first-party user session.
Close the first-party user session the caller presented.
Delete one current workspace file.
Mint a download grant for a ready current workspace file.
Read one current workspace file.
List current workspace files.
Replace one current workspace file from inline bytes or an HTTPS URL.
Cancel current work and return the session to idle.
Create a durable session and eagerly prepare its default-on sandbox in the background.
Irreversibly delete session-scoped user content; independent workspace files remain.
Read durable session metadata and sandbox preparation state.
Admit one text message; file paths are referenced in text, never attached.
List complete committed messages in immutable seal order.
Stream bounded assistant previews plus commit/reconcile/gap frames.
Mint a short-lived download for a bounded retained telemetry export.
Replay retained telemetry from compressed immutable S3 segments.
Stream live trusted assistant, tool, runtime, Logs and Traces telemetry with bounded previews.
Destroy sandbox compute while retaining session metadata and messages.
List sessions in the workspace.
Verify an admitted upload and publish it only if its private overwrite intent is still current.
Admit a direct upload for one current workspace-file name and return every bounded part grant.

message.description: A human message; never a provider body.

operationId.description: The durable operation this failure belongs to.

retryable.description: Whether an identical retry can succeed.

pendingCents.description: Rated usage not yet settled to the ledger.

completeThrough.description: All accepted facts at or before this instant are represented.

hasGap.description: Whether a poisoned or missing fact prevents complete settlement.

includesThrough.description: No fact after this instant is represented.

amountCents.description: Exact rated amount in whole cents.

model.description: Provider model identifier for model usage.

data.description: The encoded bytes. A larger payload goes through the upload surface.

clientId.description: The public Google OAuth client identifier.

redirectUri.description: The exact fixed CLI loopback callback URI registered with Google.

sha256.description: Hash of the stored payload bytes.

sizeBytes.description: Size of the stored payload in bytes.

session.description: Bearer credential held only in a dashboard `HttpOnly` cookie or transient CLI memory.

client.description: Which registered first-party callback received the authorization code.

range.description: The signed range, when the grant is partial.

url.description: The signed URL; never printed by the CLI.

effective.description: The effective value at the time of the request.

measured.description: What the request would have required.

attempted.description: What this request would have added.

apiUrl.description: The regional host to reissue against.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 pointer to the offending position.

transport.description: How the built-in sandbox MCP tool reaches it.

createdAt.description: Display time; not collection ordering authority.

name.description: Official or namespaced MCP tool name.

truncated.description: Whether full output exceeded the preview.

text.description: Complete user text; there is no attachment field.

createdAt.description: When verified webhook state registered it.

isDefault.description: Whether Stripe reports this as the default card.

consent.description: Must be true: the caller explicitly consents to saving this card for future prepaid payments.

failureCode.description: Stable bounded failure code; present only when failed.

state.description: Lifecycle of this one current overwrite.

value.description: Verified current bytes; present only when ready.

failureCode.description: Stable bounded failure code; present only when failed.

state.description: Lifecycle of this one current overwrite.

compute.description: Present only when sandbox is enabled.

mcpServerNames.description: Frozen server names; secrets and transport credentials are omitted.

network.description: Present only when sandbox is enabled.

registered.description: Frozen mount selection; hashes remain private.

activeMessageId.description: The one active root user message.

expiresAt.description: Optional earlier expiry within the launch maximum.

providerApiKey.description: Write-only session-scoped key; encrypted and never returned.

maximumLifetimeSeconds.description: Session lifetime, never more than eight hours at launch.

maximumSubagentDepth.description: Root depth is zero; children may reach depth three.

maximumSubagents.description: Exactly 12 non-root identities over the session lifetime.

packages.description: Pinned packages applied before initial suspension.

mediaType.description: Compressed NDJSON or OTLP bundle media type.

url.description: Signed S3 URL; never printed by the CLI.

truncated.description: Whether retained data is larger than this frame.

amountCents.description: Credit to buy in whole cents, within configured bounds.

successUrl.description: Browser return after provider success; not money authority.

partCount.description: How many parts the object needs.

grants.description: Every part grant, in ascending order.

name.description: The latest-only logical file name to replace immediately with pending.

parts.description: Every contiguous part declaration used to mint the checksum-bound admission grants.

etag.description: The entity tag the store returned.

headers.description: Headers the caller must replay verbatim.

sizeBytes.description: The exact Content-Length to be signed.

operationId.description: The operation, when attributable. Never populated by `usage_query`, as `sessionId`.

sessionId.description: The session, when attributable. Never populated by `usage_query`: that route answers from a coarse face that carries no session identity, and its absence is honest rather than an omission.

source.description: Which authority produced the facts. One of the `UsageAuthority` identifiers, constant per partition.

settlement.description: Whether this item is settled as of `completeThrough`.
Whether this item is settled as of `completeThrough`.

category.description: The authority whose contiguous fact sequence this frontier describes. Not a priced category: memory and compute share one.

completeThrough.description: The answer contains every matching fact at or below this sequence. Pinned on the first page and reported unchanged on every later page.

includesThrough.description: No fact above this sequence is present in the answer. Per page.

projectedSequence.description: Facts folded into the query projection.

serviceThrough.description: Service time the authority has observed through, when any fact has been admitted.

stallReason.description: Why the fold stopped, present exactly when `state` is `stalled`. A stalled frontier is the honest signal; a lag is not a stall.

stalledAt.description: The sequence the fold stopped at, present exactly when `state` is `stalled`.

state.description: Whether the fold is advancing or parked.

settlement.description: Whether this item is settled as of `completeThrough`.

frontiers.description: Pipeline frontiers, one per authority the query touched.

nextCursor.description: Continuation token. Never present for `bucket: total`: a partial total is a wrong number, so an over-budget total is refused instead of paged.

bucket.description: The time grain to answer at.

limit.description: Page size. Absent means 25. Above the maximum the request is refused, never clamped: a caller silently given fewer items than it asked for cannot tell a short page from the end of a collection.

timeRange.description: The service-time window, aligned to whole `bucket` grains in UTC. A misaligned range is refused, never widened. A range longer than 400 days is refused.

settlement.description: Whether this item is settled as of `completeThrough`.

generationId.description: The exact retained generation that answered.

resumed.description: Whether this call first resumed the suspended generation.
